capabilities: track cumulative focus time while the app window is focused
show animals arriving in a side panel at focus-time thresholds
unlock ten rarer Pro animals with a paid activation code
paste, remove, or reset the safari from settings
extras: Freemium: six animals and the timer are free; ten Pro animals need a paid activation code verified offline (no network use or telemetry). This README is for the private source repository; users install from the public distribution repository seekseep/focus-safari.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track or reward unbroken focus time spent working in notes.

requires.name: paid activation code for the Pro animals

summary: A gamified focus timer that fills a side panel with animals as your cumulative time focusing on notes grows, with paid Pro animals.
